name: from_parts_in
declaration: unsafe fn from_parts_in (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self
rules: ptr must be currently allocated via the given allocator alloc.
The alignment of T must equal the alignment with which ptr was allocated.
The size of T multiplied by capacity must equal the size in bytes with which ptr was allocated.
length must be less than or equal to capacity.
The first length values at ptr must be properly initialized values of type T.
capacity must fit the layout size with which ptr was allocated.
The allocated size in bytes must be no larger than isize::MAX.
Nothing else may use ptr after calling from_parts_in.
